title: Stale RBAC assignments
description: Finds role assignments granted to principals that no longer exist or haven't signed in, reducing attack surface.
example_prompt: "List all role assignments where: (1) the principal object no longer exists in Entra ID (orphaned SIDs), (2) the user principal hasn't signed in for > 90 days, (3) the service principal has no recent activity. Show assignment scope, role, principal display name/ID, and last sign-in date. Recommend removal."
